name: gam-integrator
description: Web GUI for GAM7: manage Google Workspace (G Suite) Drive and Gmail without the command line. Transfer ownership of whole Google Drive folders, audit storage and sharing, export mailboxes.
author: Christian Guerrero

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock: GAM_MOCK=1 concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.dev:mock:alt: GAM_MOCK=1 API_PORT=5299 concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
